sentence_stem: Although I have only one year of work experience,
correct_completion: I am very interested in this position.
full_sentence: Although I have only one year of work experience, I am very interested in this position.
acceptable_variants: I still want to work with your company.
I would like to learn quickly and work hard.

options.text: so I need the job very much.
options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a result, not a contrast. The stem already needs a contrasting clause after 'although'.

options.text: I have a lot of experience in sales.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, which says the writer has only one year of experience, so it does not complete the contrast.

options.text: I am very interested in this position.
I do not want to apply for the job.
options.why_wrong: This negative statement does not fit a formal application letter and does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that contrasts with the first part of the sentence. Here the limited experience is contrasted with a positive attitude toward the job, which is typical of formal application letters.
translation: Aunque solo tengo un año de experiencia laboral, estoy muy interesado en este puesto.
